newsitem.title: USA: Cash America sets shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Cash America sets shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Cash America International Inc on Tuesday said its board adopted a shareholder rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.

The company will distribute common stock purchase rights as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of common stock held by shareholders of record at the close of business on August 19, Cash America said in a statement.
The rights were designed to give more protection against abusive takeover tactics, it said. But the plan was not being adopted in response to any specific takeover bid.

Rights would be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or announced a tender offer which would result in 15 percent ownership, Cash America said.
Cash America provides specialty financial services.
